title: The arms of a keyed dispatch are IRIs minted from the table and the key (YAML surface)
description: T's arms are <base>T.arm.ftyp, <base>T.arm.7 for the integer key and <base>T.arm.7.str for the string "7", never blank nodes; the lone sibling in on is bddo:dispatchOnField. The YAML mirror of the text document compiles to the same graph.
